source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The desktop generator maps beta to thunderbird-beta, ESR to thunderbird-esr and the default channel to thunderbird. The template consumes wmclass as StartupWMClass. Current task configuration selects VERSION_FLAG by project, with --esr for comm-esr projects, --beta for comm-beta and an empty default; repack forwards a nonempty flag. Keep generator, template and task environment in sync. The historical stable-branch-means-ESR inference is superseded now that the current default channel exists. App ID and DBus ownership are separate values; do not mechanically copy their underscore form into StartupWMClass.
title: Flatpak identity names depend on the release channel
